instrument: Site plan PZ22-11-31, Compass Datacenters PHX II (SWC El Mirage Rd & Peoria Ave)
summary: A three-building data center campus on about 121 acres was approved by site plan under a Planned Area Development zoning, with the entitlement use recorded as a warehouse. No data-center-specific use classification was applied.
text: The site is zoned PAD (Planned Area Development) with the land use of vacant land. The approved site plan was granted the entitlement use of a warehouse.

source.citation: City of El Mirage Planning & Zoning Commission agenda packet, Jan 9, 2024, staff report SPE23-12-01

notes: Approval date per staff report: City Council, Feb 9, 2023. CONFLICT: the applicant's Dec 18, 2023 letter in the same packet gives 'February 9, 2024', which postdates the letter itself; staff report governs.
confidence_note: Site plan stipulations not read (Feb 9, 2023 council packet). Whether El Mirage's zoning code defines 'data center' at all is not checked.
